local core = map.teams[enemy].core
    local distance = (core.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
    local aim = if distance > 0.001 then look:Dot((core.Position - root.Position).Unit) else 1
    if not Rules.damageCandidate(distance, aim, Config.CastleReach) then
        attackResponse("MISS","NONE")
        return
    end
    -- Fail closed when a map wall or solid decoration occludes the castle core.
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character :: Model}
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, core.Position - root.Position, params)
    if hit and hit.Instance ~= core then
        attackResponse("MISS","BLOCKED")
        return
    end
    -- Castle damage is server-owned; client never sends its preferred damage/target.
    local priorCastleHp=match.hp[enemy]
    match.hp[enemy] = math.max(0, match.hp[enemy] - Config.CastleAttackDamage[roles[player] or "RAIDER"])
    if match.hp[enemy]<priorCastleHp then
        attackResponse("HIT","CASTLE")
    else
        attackResponse("MISS","NONE")
    end
    local winner = if EXPERIMENTAL_FIVE_EGG_MODE then nil
        else Rules.winner(match.scores, match.hp, Config.CapturesToWin)
    if winner then stopRound(winner, "CASTLE_DESTROYED") else broadcast() end

attack.Activated:Connect(function() action("ATTACK", nil) end)
-- FB-019: report the authoritative result on the existing attack button.
-- Only the authoritative server-confirmed HIT/MISS updates the same button briefly.
local originalAttackText = attack.Text
local originalAttackColor = attack.BackgroundColor3
local lastAttackFeedbackSeq = -1
local attackFeedbackVersion = 0
local function flashConfirmedAttack(message:string,color:Color3)
    attackFeedbackVersion += 1
    local version = attackFeedbackVersion
    attack.Text = message
    attack.BackgroundColor3 = color
    task.delay(.28,function()
        if attackFeedbackVersion==version and attack.Parent~=nil then
            attack.Text = originalAttackText
            attack.BackgroundColor3 = originalAttackColor
        end
    end)
end
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet:any)
    if type(packet)~="table" or packet.kind~="P0D_ATTACK_RESULT"
        or not attack.Visible or packet.serial~=lastSerial then return end
    if packet.status~="HIT" and packet.status~="MISS" then return end
    local feedbackSeq=packet.seq
    if type(feedbackSeq)~="number" or feedbackSeq%1~=0
        or feedbackSeq<=lastAttackFeedbackSeq or feedbackSeq<1 or feedbackSeq>1000000000 then return end
    lastAttackFeedbackSeq=feedbackSeq
    if packet.status=="HIT" then
        flashConfirmedAttack("⚔ 命中!",Color3.fromRGB(54,160,105))
    elseif packet.status=="MISS" then
        flashConfirmedAttack("⚔ 空振り",Color3.fromRGB(98,119,142))
    end
end)
